Enchant creature

faces.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. You get {E}{E}{E} (three energy counters), then you may pay any amount of {E}. Galvanic Discharge deals that much damage to that permanent.

faces.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.

faces.name: Storm Reading

faces.name: Galvanic Juggernaut
faces.oracleText:
